summary: Iteration 78: Tested 4 P0 features - Admin sidebar breakdown, PWA/mobile wrapper, Org Switcher, and Advanced Analytics Dashboard. All features working correctly. Admin sidebar shows 17 items (14 admin-specific + 3 governance items). PWA manifest.json and sw.js accessible with MAARS metadata. Org Switcher shows 'Personal Workspace' with 'Create Organization' option. Analytics Dashboard has 'Add Widget' and 'Auto-refresh' toggle.
